thread:
maya: FYI canary-314 (dedicated) p95 jumped ~2.6x right after merge DPC-908, customer impact on a reserved pool. Putting rollout on hold :exclamation:
liam: ugh. saw the alert in dashboard, digging into kernel-selector metrics now — looks like a change in the batching sample_rate made the selector prefer kernel_v2 for many long-seq traces
sophia: I repro locally with seq_len=1500+ and batch mix from our canary trace dump — same p95 spike. tagging the commit that introduced the change: DPC-908
arjun: CI perf job dedicated-canary-p95 failed right after that merge too, link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/dedicated-canary-p95/542 (logs attached)
infra-bot: deploybot: Canary deploy 314 failed healthcheck: p95 latency above threshold (rollback recommended)
oncall: Putting the Dedicated rollout on hold for all regions. Notifying support + sales.
maya: Recording a quick bisect plan — liam/sophia can you try bisect between DPC-900..DPC-908 to confirm exact diff? If it's the sample_rate tweak we should revert asap
liam: Doing binary search now. Initial hit at DPC-904 where batching.sample_rate changed from 0.07 -> 0.25 across routes. Kernel hint entropy increased, many requests routed to kernel_v2 which has better throughput on short sequences but regresses on long sequences
sophia: Confirmed: revert DPC-904 locally -> p95 returns to baseline. Patch diff (excerpt):
```diff
- batching:
-  sample_rate: 0.25
+ batching:
+  sample_rate: 0.07
```
liam: Also saw that KV-prefetch throttle was reading the sampler output and reduced prefetch windows for long sequences — exacerbates slow path for kernel_v2. So two compounding effects
arjun: Can we hotfix by forcing kernel selection override to kernel_v1 for heavyseq routes? Quick toggle until full revert/patch?
maya: Yes, prepare override rule: route.match(seq_len>1024) -> kernel_hint=kernel_v1. Deploy as config toggle only (no code change).
liam: Pushed config override to staging, running smoke. If green I'll push to canary gate.
sophia: Flamegraph summary (canary-314): cpu time dominated by kernel_v2 deserialization path for long ctx (~42% more wall time). Adding to issue.
cs-rep: Heads up to CS: I'm drafting a short note for affected customers, will hold until we confirm rollback/hotfix outcome.
oncall: After config toggle applied to canary, p95 dropped ~30% within 10 minutes. Still monitoring.
maya: Good. Next steps: 1) revert DPC-904 in main (small PR), 2) add CI regression test for long-seq kernel selection under increased sample_rate, 3) add guardrail in selector to avoid switching kernel for sequences > 1024 unless explicit perf profile exists.
liam: I'll open the revert PR and the CI test. Adding a perf job that runs synthetic mix with seq_len distribution skewed to long sequences.
sophia: Filing the kernel-selector issue with test vectors and flamegraph attachment: https://issues.redwood/internal/INFR-2135
arjun: Also recommend adding metric: sample_rate_effective_fraction per route so we can see when sampling causes selector churn.
maya: Thanks team. Keeping rollout on hold until revert lands and CI passes. I put an incident note in #incidents and pinged enterprise leads. :thumbsup:
liam: small note — this one was subtle because sample_rate is meant to improve heuristics, but it needs to be route-aware. We'll follow up with design doc on safer sampling.
sophia: Agreed. Will propose a changelog entry and a migration plan for Dedicated customers who tuned sample_rate.
oncall: Will update customer thread when revert is merged and hotfix validated.
maya: Closing loop here once revert merged + canary stable for 30m. Thanks all.
